items.title: Why opportunity charging is winning as robot fleets scale
items.summary: Ben Waters explains why opportunity charging is becoming essential for keeping autonomous robot fleets moving, scalable, and operationally efficient. The post Why opportunity charging is winning as robot fleets scale appeared first on The Robot Report.
